definitions.explanation: A group of people related by blood or marriage, especially an extended family or clan. Often implies a family with social standing, history, or shared identity.

examples.japanese: {一族|いちぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦{名門|めいもん}→名門：11955_meimon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一族|いちぞく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: I was born into a distinguished family.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一族|いちぞく}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恒例|こうれい}→恒例：12597_kourei⟧だ。
examples.english: It's customary for the entire family to gather at our grandparents' house on New Year's.

notes:
{一族|いちぞく} refers to an extended family or clan, typically implying a larger kinship group than ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ (immediate family).

FORMS:
⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + {族|ぞく} (tribe, clan) = one clan/family

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一族|いちぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: the clan gathers
- {一族|いちぞく}{郎党|ろうとう}: the whole clan and retainers
- ⟦{名門|めいもん}→名門：11955_meimon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一族|いちぞく}: distinguished family

{一族|いちぞく} VS {家族|かぞく}:
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ refers to the immediate family living together. {一族|いちぞく} is broader, encompassing relatives, branches of the family, and sometimes retainers. It often appears in historical or literary contexts.
